div.div:
narrative:
1) client requests to liteproxy service with a given proxy url over https
2) api gateway applies rate limiting and ssl temrination and servers the request over http to the api server
3) api server checks if the request is cached in our redis instance if so return the cached response to the client
4) if the proxied url isn't cached we send a request to the desired upstream
5) we return the request to the api gateway still over http
6) we return the request to the client
